swarm.name: The Hem
swarm.blurb: A network of collecting machines that spins plants and fragments into an expanding protective cloth. It keeps mistaking confinement for care.

crew.name: Wren
crew.blurb: Field medic. Keeps the crew running with thread and solder.

crew.name: Ox
crew.blurb: Shield bearer. Has walked out of worse.

crew.name: Kestrel
crew.blurb: Breaker. Finds the seam in anything and pulls.

creatures.name: Accession Tick
creatures.blurb: It snatches loose supplies for a collection nobody ordered.

creatures.name: Trail Moth
creatures.blurb: Its lantern draws more machines. Put it out early.

creatures.name: Wreath Winder
creatures.blurb: It rolls along paths, gathering cut branches and anyone in its way.

creatures.name: Label Stitcher
creatures.blurb: It joins the wrong records to plants and tangles the crew in wire.

creatures.name: Provenance Hound
creatures.blurb: It tracks anything without a recognized origin and packs it for transport.

creatures.name: Phenology Clock
creatures.blurb: Its false flowering alarm interrupts the crew at regular intervals.

creatures.name: Herbarium Presser
creatures.blurb: It closes its specimen boards around other machines. Break its protection.

creatures.name: Dye Indexer
creatures.blurb: It stains targets for the collectors. Its tanks smell of crushed plants.

creatures.name: Bed Sorter
creatures.blurb: Its spade arms rearrange anything that does not fit the row.

creatures.name: Irrigation Bailiff
creatures.blurb: It diverts water to damaged machines. Stop it before its repairs take hold.

creatures.name: Genome Mapper
creatures.blurb: It lays thread between collectors and calls reinforcements to each junction.

creatures.name: Portal Custodian
creatures.blurb: It shields the collection line and forces everything through its sorting gate.

creatures.name: Grand Curator
creatures.blurb: A mobile glasshouse locks plants away from light and water. Its shields protect the harvest and the bolt of dyed cloth inside.

creatures.name: Seed Keeper
creatures.blurb: This careful keeper moves viable seeds to safe beds and patches the crew.

creatures.name: Catalogue Keeper
creatures.blurb: A gardener uses plant dyes to mark safe routes and confuse collectors.

events.title: Swapped labels
events.text: A watering machine is approaching two mismatched plants. Wren can sort the tags or take the spare repair kit before it arrives.

options.label: Sort the tags
options.result: Wren saves both plants and uses the remaining clean water to tend the crew.

options.label: Take the spare kit
options.result: The kit yields 35 gold in useful parts. The plants must wait for another gardener.

events.title: Packet in the grass
events.text: A collector is closing on a dropped seed packet. Ox can pull it free, or the crew can distract the machine with a bag of parts.

options.label: Pull it free
options.result: Ox recovers the seeds, but the collector clips the crew on the way out.

options.label: Leave a decoy
options.result: The collector takes 25 gold in parts. The keeper retrieves the seeds safely.

events.title: Early bloom
events.text: A false alarm opened a branch of buds in the cold. Covering it takes supplies; resetting the bell takes a hard reach.

options.label: Buy insulating cloth
options.result: The branch is wrapped and the keeper receives 30 gold for the cloth.

options.label: Reach the bell
options.result: The alarm stops. The cold and sharp bracket leave the crew bruised.

events.title: Blue crossing
events.text: A dye spill attracts collectors. Wash a narrow route or use pigment to lay a false trail and take the spare supplies.

options.label: Wash a crossing
options.result: The wash clears a route; Wren uses the clean water to tend the crew.

options.label: Lay a false trail
options.result: The collectors follow the pigment. The crew pockets 30 gold in abandoned supplies.

events.title: Closing press
events.text: A specimen sheet is caught in a cycling press. Kestrel can pull it out or dismantle the press for parts.

options.label: Pull out the sheet
options.result: Kestrel saves the record; the closing board catches the crew.

options.label: Dismantle the press
options.result: The crew recovers 40 gold in fittings. The record tears in the process.

events.title: Cold storage
events.text: A seed crate needs shelter before its collector returns. A nearby keeper offers either medical supplies or a defensive lesson for help moving it.

options.label: Take medical supplies
options.result: The seeds reach shade and Wren uses the supplies on the crew.

options.label: Learn to brace
options.result: The seeds reach shade. The keeper demonstrates how to brace behind a crate.

story.intro: The Hem is taking dye plants and their records. Wren checks a stripped bed for roots that can still grow. Ox lifts the first collector off the path.

chapters.title: Missing color
chapters.text: Madder roots and woad leaves are disappearing into labeled containers. Kestrel finds the same fine thread on every empty bed. The crew assumes the Hem is gathering dye for itself.

chapters.title: Care in the wrong place
chapters.text: Collectors pair plants with records, then lock both away. Wren finds seedlings drying inside a sealed case. A good label has not kept them alive.

chapters.title: The moving glasshouse
chapters.text: Thread lines converge on a mobile glasshouse. Ox tests its panels and finds them heavily shielded. A length of dyed cloth is visible through the glass.

story.bossIntro: The Grand Curator draws its plants behind glass and braces the doors. Kestrel looks for a seam while Ox holds the frame. Wren asks them to keep the plants intact.
story.outro: The glasshouse opens. The plants can be returned, but the cloth is already woven. A tagless spool points the crew toward a mill.

creatures.name: Order Roller
creatures.blurb: It wraps machines in scraps carrying bad orders.

creatures.name: Bee Wheel
creatures.blurb: It rolls after loose fiber, pulling its growing skein behind it.

creatures.name: Accession Crab
creatures.blurb: It stores useful parts in numbered cases and scuttles away.

creatures.name: Shift Clerk
creatures.blurb: It sends out helpers to enforce an impossible shift.

creatures.name: Sewing-room Stitcher
creatures.blurb: It makes empty figures from discarded clothes. Cut it before they multiply.

creatures.name: Floor Overseer
creatures.blurb: It speeds up belts and catches the crew at the worst moment.

creatures.name: Three-era Dyer
creatures.blurb: Its rotating vats stain targets for the mill machines.

creatures.name: Lesson Loom
creatures.blurb: It winds a tight cloth screen around the production line.

creatures.name: Tour Guide
creatures.blurb: It herds everyone into a single tightening thread line.

creatures.name: Makerspace Mender
creatures.blurb: It repairs the line and its guards. Rush it before it can mend both.

creatures.name: Hall Scheduler
creatures.blurb: It folds tables into barriers and blocks the crew with moving partitions.

creatures.name: Shelf Catalog
creatures.blurb: It calls clerks while rolling shelves into the crew’s path.

creatures.name: Thread City Engine
creatures.blurb: It calls workers and shields the line while its shuttle sweeps the floor. The cloth is a cover, not a stockpile.

creatures.name: Circle Spinner
creatures.blurb: A patient spinner keeps a hand-powered line open between safe rooms.

creatures.name: Bench Repairer
creatures.blurb: A reclaimed workshop helper patches gear with salvaged parts.

events.title: Rewinding line
events.text: A spinning circle’s lifeline is winding back across a gap. Reach the far wheel, or pay the circle for a replacement rope.

options.label: Reach the wheel
options.result: The line stays up, but the crew scrapes against the turning spokes.

options.label: Buy a replacement
options.result: The circle receives 30 gold and lays a new line safely.

events.title: Between houses
events.text: A bundle of belongings lies between two moving exhibit houses. Ox can hold a wall or Kestrel can strip the driving gear.

options.label: Hold the wall
options.result: The belongings are saved. Ox and the crew take a battering from the wall.

options.label: Strip the gear
options.result: The houses stop and the crew recovers 35 gold in parts. The bundle is crushed.

events.title: Conflicting orders
events.text: Two groups of machines are arguing over printed orders. Forge a diversion or collect the printing supplies while they argue.

options.label: Forge a diversion
options.result: The machines jam each other’s line. Kestrel learns the same interruption trick.

options.label: Collect the supplies
options.result: The crew takes 40 gold in supplies while the argument continues.

events.title: Crossed streams
events.text: Leaking vats surround a repair drone. Divert the streams to reach its supplies, or let Wren use its repair station.

options.label: Take the supplies
options.result: The drone yields 35 gold in parts after the dye is diverted.

options.label: Use the station
options.result: Wren repairs the crew while the drone stays with its supplies.

events.title: Tethered bench
events.text: A workbench is tied to the production line. Cut its threads carefully or tear the tools free before the belt pulls them away.

options.label: Cut the threads
options.result: The bench is freed. A repairer teaches Kestrel how to break through a shield.

options.label: Tear out the tools
options.result: The crew takes 45 gold in tools. The bench follows the belt.

events.title: High bundle
events.text: A hoist has caught a supply bundle between floors. Cranking it wakes the machines below. Cutting the chain risks the contents.

options.label: Crank it down
options.result: The bundle reaches the floor, but awakened machines strike the crew.

options.label: Cut the chain
options.result: The bundle breaks open. The crew salvages 25 gold in parts.

story.intro: The spool leads to a mill full of moving belts. Ox braces a doorway while Wren frees a trapped hand spinner. The Hem has brought the garden harvest here.

chapters.title: From plant to thread
chapters.text: The vats hold the garden’s colors. Wheels twist dyed fiber into thread, and looms feed it into broad sheets. Kestrel follows the cloth through the line.

chapters.title: A cover, not a haul
chapters.text: The sheets are padded and hemmed for protection. Wren finds a packing pattern for a textile collection. The Hem was gathering materials to cover something, not simply stripping the garden for profit.

chapters.title: One continuous sheet
chapters.text: The machines refuse to cut the cloth into separate supports. Their plan shows doors and people sealed beneath the same sheet. Ox says a shelter needs a way out.

story.bossIntro: The Thread City Engine keeps the line running under guard. Its shuttle sweeps the floor while fresh machines arrive. Kestrel aims for the feed; Wren keeps the spinners clear.
story.outro: The engine stops and the crew frees its workers. The destination is a textile museum. The Hem’s instructions call for a permanent cover over the entire collection.

creatures.name: Conservation Mite
creatures.blurb: It wraps anything moving as if it were dust. Break the cluster early.

creatures.name: Spindle Drone
creatures.blurb: Its cord binds the crew and interrupts their work.

creatures.name: Postcard Courier
creatures.blurb: It folds loose supplies into tidy parcels and carries them away.

creatures.name: Fragment Assembler
creatures.blurb: It bolts scraps into false wholes and calls more machines to fill the gaps.

creatures.name: Map Roller
creatures.blurb: It rolls competing street plans across the floor and cuts off movement.

creatures.name: Mounting Rig
creatures.blurb: It pins objects to a rigid support and shields nearby machines.

creatures.name: Raffia Braider
creatures.blurb: Its woven barricades protect other machines. Break the tension lines.

creatures.name: Quilt Presser
creatures.blurb: Its padded layers absorb blows while it pushes into the crew.

creatures.name: Journal Referee
creatures.blurb: It stalls the crew under a stack of conflicting notes.

creatures.name: Climate Regulator
creatures.blurb: It repairs the final enclosure and interrupts anyone trying to open it.

creatures.name: Coverlet Frame
creatures.blurb: It turns spare parts into guards and shields itself behind a woven panel.

creatures.name: Material Drone
creatures.blurb: It copies an opponent’s action while changing its outer skin.

creatures.name: Composite Curator
creatures.blurb: It calls guards and locks the crew in place as its wide frame sweeps the room. Its false joins would seal people and textiles together.

creatures.name: Fragment Reader
creatures.blurb: A researcher finds the false joins in the Hem’s cloth.

creatures.name: Conservation Volunteer
creatures.blurb: A volunteer makes safe supports for fragile objects and tends the crew.

events.title: A missing piece
events.text: A fragment fits a gap in a machine’s armor. A reader also needs it to demonstrate how to unpick a false join.

options.label: Give it to the reader
options.result: The reader shows Kestrel how to open a protected seam.

options.label: Fit it into the armor
options.result: The machine locks up and yields 40 gold in parts. The fragment stays in the plate.

events.title: Two plans
events.text: Two plans place a doorway on different streets. A researcher can compare them while Wren treats the crew, or the crew can sell spare map fittings.

options.label: Help compare the plans
options.result: The researcher finds the doorway and Wren treats the crew during the work.

options.label: Recover the fittings
options.result: The fittings yield 35 gold. The researcher continues the comparison alone.

events.title: A thread to follow
events.text: A spinning wheel has bound a volunteer. Cut the line quickly or buy a tool that lets the volunteer unwind it safely.

options.label: Cut the line
options.result: The volunteer is free. The snapping cord lashes the crew.

options.label: Buy the tool
options.result: The volunteer unwinds the cord; the tool costs 25 gold.

events.title: The warm cup
events.text: A climate alarm has mistaken a warm cup for a gallery problem. Move it by hand or use a padded carrier from the volunteer’s supplies.

options.label: Move it by hand
options.result: The alarm stops, but the hot cup burns the crew.

options.label: Buy the carrier
options.result: The cup is moved safely. The carrier costs 20 gold.

events.title: Padded delivery
events.text: A padded bundle carries parts to the enclosure. Open it for salvage or use the padding to rest and mend.

options.label: Salvage the parts
options.result: The crew recovers 45 gold in parts and leaves the padding behind.

options.label: Use the padding
options.result: Wren tends the crew on the padding. The parts roll away with the bundle.

events.title: Four samples
events.text: A study table explains fiber, color, structure and decoration. A volunteer offers to teach the crew one of two techniques before the loom returns.

options.label: Learn early repair
options.result: Wren studies the supports and learns to patch damage sooner.

options.label: Learn a wide sweep
options.result: Ox practices clearing a path through several moving frames.

story.intro: The Hem has reached the textile collection. Its cloth already covers a doorway. Wren helps a volunteer lift the edge without pulling the fragile fabric beneath it.

chapters.title: Pieces and places
chapters.text: Fragments, garments and maps are being joined into one display. Each has its own shape and history. Kestrel finds seams where the joins do not fit.

chapters.title: The cost of a cover
chapters.text: The Hem means to protect the collection from wear. Its plan would also seal the people inside and make future care impossible. Ox holds a passage open for the volunteers.

chapters.title: Separate supports
chapters.text: Wren and the volunteers cut the mill cloth into supports suited to individual objects. The Hem keeps feeding the remaining sheet to its central frame. Kestrel follows the tension to the final join.

story.bossIntro: The Composite Curator draws the last sheet tight. It calls guards, catches the crew in its bindings and swings its frame across the room. Ox holds the opening while Kestrel reaches the false join.
story.outro: The final join comes apart. The Hem’s frame goes still, and the volunteers carry the cut cloth to their worktables. Wren checks the people first. Ox keeps the door open. Kestrel leaves the last seam loose.
